## Diagnosis
What remains is the sentence that explains a thing the sentence before it showed, and cutting those whole is the only cutting left that quickens instead of chops.

## Suggestions
### 1
Original: They point in different directions.
Replacement: CUT
Buys: The next sentence shows the two directions; this one announces them.

## Defect classes
### A
Class: a sentence announcing its paragraph rather than being it
Instance: They point in different directions.
Sweep: every paragraph opener in the article

### B
Class: reported speech held at arm's length by a scaffold verb
Instance: told the room that
Sweep: every attribution in the opening

## Paragraph move
Cut the repeat paragraph.
